description: Files a task produces instead of the repository committing them, and the task that writes each one. A workspace whose src/** imports one of them must declare the producing task in the depends of its typecheck, test and dry-run tasks, or those tasks race the export that creates their input. tasks/_lib/check-manifests.ts enforces it.

files.reason: The demo Worker serves a synthetic snapshot exported from the local pipeline experiment. It is git-ignored so that an export taken on some developer's machine cannot be committed as if it were data.
